summary: Quartzsea Acquisition Corp, a Cayman-incorporated Nasdaq-listed blank-check company, filed an 8-K on September 19, 2026 disclosing a $175,000 deposit into its trust account to extend the deadline for consummating its initial business combination from September 19, 2026 to October 19, 2026. The one-month extension is authorized under charter and trust agreement amendments approved by shareholders on June 23, 2026, allowing month-to-month extensions through October 19, 2026, at the lesser of $175,000 or $0.033 per outstanding public share. This signals no announced deal yet; watch for a target announcement, further extensions, or liquidation risk as the outside date approaches.
